sources.title: Eating disorders: recognition and treatment
sources.source_context: NICE clinical guideline, United Kingdom. Relevant to assessment principles, not Malaysian service or privacy rules.
quotes: Be aware that, in addition to the points in recommendation 1.2.6, children and young people with an eating disorder may also present with faltering growth (for example, a low weight or height for their age) or delayed puberty.
Do not use single measures such as BMI or duration of illness to determine whether to offer treatment for an eating disorder.
If an eating disorder is suspected after an initial assessment, refer immediately to a community-based, age-appropriate eating disorder service for further assessment or treatment.

sources.title: Bulimia
sources.section: When and where to get medical help; Health risks of bulimia
sources.source_context: NHS public medical guidance, United Kingdom. Not diagnosis of the fictional child or a Malaysian care pathway.
quotes: It's important to get help for bulimia. Treatment and support will give you the best chance of recovery.
It's important to get help even if you only have some of the signs.
It may make things easier if you bring someone you trust with you to your appointment.
Sometimes, without the right support, bulimia can be life-threatening.

sources.title: Befrienders KL homepage
sources.source_context: Provider's current self-description, not confirmation that a particular call will connect. KL service must not be confused with the separately listed Ipoh centre.
quotes: Feeling overwhelmed, distressed, or having thoughts of suicide? You are not alone. Call +603-7627 2929 — our 24-hour helpline offers emotional support.
Befrienders KL runs entirely on donations. Every contribution — no matter the size — keeps our 24-hour helpline free and accessible to all.
sources.limitation: Homepage describes its service as confidential; this is a provider claim, not a verified guarantee about all centres or all circumstances. Our-services URL returned404.

decisions: Remove reassurance based solely on height/weight; those measurements do not establish absence of an eating disorder or justify body-shaming.
Do not promise a minor's medical appointment will be hidden from parents. No Malaysian confidentiality/consent rule has been established here.
Separate emotional listening from medical assessment. Do not defer medical help until an unverified helpline schedule or until symptoms worsen.
Any fictional consultation, name, age, location, response and successful contact must be labelled as adaptation, not observed source evidence.
